newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Retevision flotation schedule unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Retevision flotation schedule unchanged.

text.p: The scheduled privatisation of Spain's Retevision S.A. has not been changed and a 60-80 percent stake of its capital will be sold by the end of the second quarter, a spokesman said on Monday.
He was denying a report in Spanish financial daily Expansion on a possible delay in the sale process of the TV channel.
"We are still expecting that the privatisation auction will be over by the second quarter," said the spokesman.
The firm is expected to become Spain's second basic telephone operator after Telefonica once it is held privately.
The spokesman said that in the coming weeks the Development Minister will publish guidelines for companies interested in buying a stake in Retevision.
However a decisive step in the process will be the pricing of Telefonica's services for Retevision.
"The framework for interconnection (between the two operators) is a crucial issue for companies interested in Retevision," said the spokesman.
Companies tipped to be interested in buying a stake in Retevision are France Telecom, Spain's Banco Central Hispano and Deutsche Telekom.
